processes.name: Lac Operon Regulation
processes.description: The lac operon is a classic example of prokaryotic gene regulation, demonstrating how bacteria respond to environmental glucose and lactose levels through transcriptional control.

processes.name: DNA Replication Initiation at oriC
processes.description: DNA replication initiation in E. coli occurs at the origin of replication (oriC) through a highly regulated process involving DnaA protein and replisome assembly.

processes.name: Transcription Initiation and Regulation
processes.description: Transcription in E. coli is initiated by RNA polymerase holoenzyme binding to promoter regions, regulated by transcription factors and environmental signals.

processes.name: Cell Cycle Control and CDK Regulation
processes.description: The eukaryotic cell cycle in budding yeast is controlled by cyclin-dependent kinases (CDKs) which partner with different cyclins at different cell cycle stages.
